title: Ravens expect centers Jovaughn Gwyn, Ethan Pocic to miss extended time

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens expect centers Jovaughn Gwyn, Ethan Pocic to miss extended time
sources.description: The Ravens saw two centers leave Sunday's win over the Cowboys with injuries and head coach Jesse Minter said on Monday that they don't expect to have either one of them back in the lineup for quite a while.
